Botox vs. Fillers: Do you actually know the difference? 🤔👇

​These two popular treatments often get mixed up, but they serve completely different functions to help you achieve your aesthetic goals! Here is the quick breakdown:

​Botox (Muscle Relaxer): 
​What it does: Relaxes the underlying muscles.

​Best for: Smoothing out lines caused by continuous muscle movements (dynamic wrinkles)—like crow's feet around the eyes and horizontal lines over the forehead.

​Dermal Fillers (Volume Restorer): 
​What it does: Adds physical volume back to the skin.

​Best for: Plumping up areas experiencing structural volume loss—such as hollows under the eyes, flat cheeks, along the jawline, or across the forehead.

​✨ The Ultimate Goal?
​Sometimes, the most natural-looking, youthful rejuvenation actually requires a combination of both treatments!

​Because every face is unique, the right approach can only be decided through a personalized, expert consultation.

Praslin and La Digue offer endless beaches and cafes and that typical island laidback vibe. I finally finished reading an entire book within a week ('Anxious People' by Fredrik Backman). Creole food is comforting, the people are honest and friendly, the air is clean and the waters are a crystal turquoise! The practice of Dermatology is much more than treating beauty related concerns. Having said that, skin and hair related ailments, both aesthetic and medical in nature, can affect anyone - Doctors and Dermatologists included.
I remember my Dermatologist colleagues from my residency days were all expecting around the same time as me. While other women world pray for normal deliveries without diabetes and high blood pressure, us Dermatologists would pray "Oh God, please dont give me Melasma, there's no damn cure!!" It wasn't the condition itself but the critical staring and comments that it would inevitably invite.

We like in a era of perfectionism - we expect nothing short of the best from ourselves, our partners and our children. But so many skin conditions are auto-immume by nature. And I fear that our modern tendencies of constant nitpicking, self-loathing and self-critiquing only triggers our bodies to respond via autoimmunity. Our bodies end up turning on ourselves in response to constant negativity - either external, or internalized.

Something to reflect upon?

And some of the smaller shacks and cafes have the most authentic home-made Goan food, the grumpy Goan uncles and aunties notwithstanding lol. Choriz Unndo, Sorpotel, Feni, Urrack & Kokum juice, Bebinca, Cafreal & Xacuti, Ros Omlette, Goan Prawn curry, Amsol,  Sannas & Fish Cutlets, Rawa fried Fish and Fish thalis .. Goa is *not* for the vegetarian lol.
All those endless Christmas carols are stuck in my ears till New Years like brain worms now. Goans sure love their Christmas home decorations extra tacky! Not just lights and stars .. Each house seems to be competing with the neighbour for the most colorful paints, multicolored lights, giant raindeers and inflatable Santa's!
This year I discovered that Goa is so much more than just "the poor man's Brazil".
I had my first DSD scuba dive, off Isla Grande island with Aquazen Adventures. It will be the memory of a lifetime, despite the murky waters with a visibility of just 2 metres. Missy here was the first one to jump into the freezing pool at 7 am for her pool training and the 1st one to do her back-roll entry toss off her boat into the ocean 😎!

The 3 part - Goa Chitra, Goa Chakra and Goa Cruti Museum is a mind boggling privately owned ethnographic Museum showcasing over 40000 artifacts in a 1 lakh sq feet space. These are the private collection of Victor Hugo Gomes over 30 years - showing the life of Goans over the years, their agricultural and household material, the Portuguese years, and a collection of wheels, carts and palanquins from across India. Goosebumps the entire time!

You wear sunscreen. But are you wearing enough? ☀️

For your entire body, an adult typically needs around 30 mL, roughly the amount that fits in a shot glass.

Reapply every 2 hours, and after swimming, sweating, or towel drying.

Healthy skin starts with consistent protection.
